name: scrutiny-collector-zfs
description: Scrutiny ZFS Pool Collector (Hub/Spoke mode). Monitors ZFS pool health and sends data to the Scrutiny web server. Requires a running Scrutiny web server instance. Only available for amd64 (x86_64) systems.

variables.name: API Endpoint
variables.description: Scrutiny web server URL (e.g. http://scrutiny-web:8080). Required.

variables.name: Host ID
variables.description: Unique identifier for this collector host.

variables.name: Cron Schedule
variables.description: ZFS pool data collection schedule (cron format). Default: every 15 minutes.

variables.name: Run on Startup
variables.description: Run ZFS pool data collection immediately on container startup.
